name: Fahad Md Kamal
tagline: Building Scalable Cloud-Native Multi-Tenant Infrastructure for Enterprise Systems
summary: Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and scaling cloud-native, multi-tenant infrastructure. Proven track record of building reliable backend systems in Python and TypeScript that abstract over cloud providers. Expertise in event-driven architecture, messaging pipelines (Kafka, Redis Pub/Sub), containerization (Docker), and deploying services across AWS and Azure environments.
technicalSummary: Specialized in designing event-driven architectures for high-throughput systems, with expertise in microservices patterns, serverless computing, and AI/LLM integration. Led teams handling 10,000+ concurrent users and processing 5M+ records with focus on measurable performance improvements and cost optimization strategies.
